Mastoid process — 乳突
Styloid process — 茎突

text.aria-label: Body of the mandible — 下颌体
Posterior belly of digastric — 二腹肌后腹
Hyoid bone — 舌骨
Mylohyoid line — 下颌舌骨线
Mylohyoid raphe — 下颌舌骨肌缝
Anterior belly of digastric — 二腹肌前腹
Mylohyoid — 下颌舌骨肌
Origin area — 起点区
Insertion area — 止点区
Origin → insertion — 起点 → 止点
Digastric — 二腹肌
Origin: digastric fossa of the mandible (anterior belly); mastoid notch of the temporal bone (posterior belly) — 起点：下颌骨二腹肌窝（前腹）；颞骨乳突切迹（后腹）
text.tspan: Origin: digastric fossa of the mandible (anterior belly); mastoid notch of the temporal bone (posterior belly)
起点：下颌骨二腹肌窝（前腹）；颞骨乳突切迹（后腹）

text.aria-label: Insertion: intermediate tendon, held to the hyoid bone by a fibrous sling — 止点：中间腱，由纤维环系于舌骨
text.tspan: Insertion: intermediate tendon, held to the hyoid bone by a fibrous sling
止点：中间腱，由纤维环系于舌骨

text.aria-label: Stylohyoid — 茎突舌骨肌
Origin: styloid process of the temporal bone — 起点：颞骨茎突
text.tspan: Origin: styloid process of the temporal bone

text.aria-label: Insertion: body of the hyoid bone near the greater horn — 止点：舌骨体与大角交界处
text.tspan: Insertion: body of the hyoid bone near the greater horn
止点：舌骨体与大角交界处

text.aria-label: Mylohyoid — 下颌舌骨肌
Origin: mylohyoid line of the mandible — 起点：下颌骨的下颌舌骨线
text.tspan: Origin: mylohyoid line of the mandible
起点：下颌骨的下颌舌骨线

text.aria-label: Insertion: mylohyoid raphe and body of the hyoid bone — 止点：下颌舌骨肌缝和舌骨体
text.tspan: Insertion: mylohyoid raphe and body of the hyoid bone
止点：下颌舌骨肌缝和舌骨体

text.aria-label: Geniohyoid — 颏舌骨肌
Origin: inferior mental spine of the mandible — 起点：下颌骨下颏棘
text.tspan: Origin: inferior mental spine of the mandible

text.aria-label: Insertion: body of the hyoid bone — 止点：舌骨体
text.tspan: Insertion: body of the hyoid bone

text.aria-label: Infrahyoid muscles are not drawn. They hold the hyoid bone steady from below so that the suprahyoid muscles can open the jaw. — 图中未画舌骨下肌。它们从下方固定舌骨，使舌骨上肌能够张口。
text.tspan: Infrahyoid muscles are not drawn. They hold the hyoid bone steady from below so that the suprahyoid muscles can open the jaw.
图中未画舌骨下肌。它们从下方固定舌骨，使舌骨上肌能够张口。
Schematic; pathway and layers are simplified.
解剖示意；走行与层次经过简化。
